judgment: It is good to set out.
image: The marsh drowns the trees: Great Excess.
So the noble one stands alone without fear,
lines: A dry poplar puts out shoots.
An old man gets a young wife.
A dry poplar puts out flowers.
An old woman gets a young husband.

notes.name_en: 大過 great going-past; paired with 62 Small Excess. Not Wilhelm's 'Preponderance of the Great'.
notes.L6: 過涉滅頂 fording past, head drowned (滅頂) — yet 無咎, the paradox kept.
